app.title: CLAD Assessment
app.subtitle: LabVIEW Core 1 & Core 2
language.label: Language
setup.heading: Generate your quiz
setup.intro: Choose a language and how many questions you want. Narrow by topic or level if you need to.
setup.questionCountHint: Between {min} and {max}. Available with the current filters: {available}.
setup.questionCountCapped: Only {available} questions are available with the current filters. The quiz will contain {available} questions.
setup.shuffleOptionsHint: Recommended: in this bank the correct answer always occupies the first original position.
setup.noQuestionsForFilters: No selected topic or level contains any questions. Adjust the filters.
setup.contentLanguageNotice: The question bank is available in Spanish only. The interface follows your chosen language, but question text is kept untranslated.
resume.heading: Resume previous quiz?
resume.body: We found an unfinished quiz from {date} with {answered} of {total} questions answered.
documents.heading: Reference documents
documents.intro: Add the course PDFs so explanations are grounded in their actual content. Files are processed in your browser and never uploaded.
documents.dropHint: Drop PDF files here, or activate to browse
documents.none: No documents loaded. Explanations will show the question bank annotation only.
documents.error.not-a-pdf: “{name}” is not a valid PDF file.
documents.error.too-large: “{name}” exceeds the maximum supported size ({limit} MB).
documents.error.corrupt: “{name}” could not be read; the file appears to be damaged.
documents.error.encrypted: “{name}” is password-protected and cannot be read.
documents.error.no-extractable-text: “{name}” contains no extractable text (it is most likely a scanned document). It cannot be used as a documentary source.
quiz.abandonConfirm: The answers in this quiz will be lost. Do you want to leave?
quiz.contentFallbackHint: This question has no translation in the data file and is shown in its original language.
confirm.heading: Finish the quiz?
confirm.unanswered: You have {count} unanswered question(s). Are you sure you want to submit?
results.heading: Results
explanations.heading: Explanation
explanations.whyCorrect: Why the correct answer is correct
explanations.documentExtractHint: Text reproduced verbatim from the document shown. The application does not rephrase or add content.
explanations.bankAnnotationHint: Text included in the questions JSON file. It does not come from the reference documents.
explanations.notice.noDocumentsLoaded: No reference documents were loaded, so no document-based explanation could be produced.
explanations.notice.noSufficientEvidence: No supporting information was found in the provided documents.
explanations.notice.bankOnly: Showing the question bank annotation, which has not been verified against the reference documents.
explanations.notice.languageMismatch: The available documentation is in another language; extracts are shown in the original document language.
explanations.none: No explanation is available for this question.
export.heading: Export
export.error: The file could not be generated. Please try again.
export.empty: No questions match the selected content.
error.heading: Something went wrong
error.bank.invalid-json: The question database could not be loaded. Please verify the JSON file.
error.bank.unrecognized-schema: The file was read successfully, but it does not contain a recognizable list of questions.
error.bank.network: The question database could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
error.bank.validation: The question database contains errors and cannot be used.
error.quiz.no-questions-available: No questions are available with the selected filters.
error.documentsUnavailable: The question database was loaded successfully, but the reference documents are unavailable.
validation.heading: Question bank check
validation.excluded: {count} question(s) were excluded because of structural errors.
validation.bank.empty: The file contains no usable questions.
validation.bank.notObject: The file does not have the expected structure.
validation.question.missingCorrectAnswer: Question without a declared correct answer.
validation.question.correctAnswerNotAnOp: The correct answer does not match any option.
bank.heading: Question bank
bank.uploadHint: It must follow the same structure as the bundled bank.
